protocol_snapshot.scope: Major revision; original inputs and manuscript are read-only. All new outputs are kept in this directory.
protocol_snapshot.selection_loss: pooled inner-validation mean squared error; no outer-test outcome is used for selection
protocol_snapshot.window_rule: Reference-coordinate windows: subdivide original at-most-25-SNP/50kb windows for scales 5/10, retain for 25, merge two/four consecutive same-chromosome windows for 50/100. Boundaries are outcome-independent. Mean dosage weights all retained SNPs equally within each window.
protocol_snapshot.fair_ablation: Use exactly the legacy 202747 marker indices and 83-accession allele indicators for SNP, regional linear and local Gaussian models; fixed reference window 25. Match the legacy folds and hyperparameter choices where reproducing old numbers, and distinguish this ablation from fully inductive evaluation.
protocol_snapshot.strict_preprocessing: Every inner/outer training split estimates the allele convention, retains biallelic polymorphic markers with training MAF>0.05, and estimates feature scales. SNP/linear/local kernels all use the same retained indicators. Constant regional features are removed by training-only checks. Centering and trace normalization use only training kernels and are frozen for the cross kernel.
protocol_snapshot.additional_comparisons: Strong baselines and sensitivity analyses are not selected post hoc according to significance.
metrics: calibration slope: observed regressed on predictions
protocol_snapshot.uncertainty: Repeat metrics describe split variability, not independent biological replications. Report paired differences and conditional accession/ancestry-cluster bootstrap intervals with explicit limitations; retain Nadeau-Bengio only as approximate sensitivity. Add a training-refitted robustness analysis rather than treating saved predictions as covering training-set uncertainty. Phenotype signal tests are distinct from model-superiority tests.
protocol_snapshot.external_policy: Freeze all model selection using the training cohort only. Audit overlaps by canonical genotype column/ecotype ID, not names alone. Do not optimize models on external outcomes.
protocol_snapshot.robustness: Retain all accessions in the main analysis. Prespecified sensitivity leaves out the single maximum-DSDS50 accession and reports its identity; do not search for favorable exclusions.
protocol_snapshot.disclosure: This protocol was set for the revision after reading reviewer comments; it is not prospectively registered before the original study. Report all completed outcomes irrespective of direction.

rice_window_override.source_density: One randomly selected marker per 120 kb bin in published bin_120 selection 1; gaps are not exactly 120 kb
rice_window_override.rule:
Greedy disjoint windows in chromosome/position/ID order, NOT CSV order.

    A window stops before exceeding the marker cap or last-first > maxspan.
    Membership is frozen before training MAF filtering; empty windows vanish
    and retained dosages get equal weights within each remaining window.
rice_window_override.different_search_range_disclosure: Rice uses only prespecified 5/10/25-marker caps with 3 Mb maximum span. Arabidopsis protocol uses 5/10/25/50/100 and its 50 kb base windows. NOT identical genomic windows or identical window search space.
